Display-only notebook. Frozen composite-model outputs; no statistical refits.
All fourteen pre-existing biofilm candidates are retained. Main and interval
companion figures use the same two specifications and two DNA phase views.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(ggplot2);library(patchwork);library(grid)})
out <- commandArgs(TRUE)[1]; stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
paths <- c(models=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_condition_models_2026-09-14-v1/all_specifications.tsv"),
 obs_condition=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_condition_models_2026-09-14-v1/model_observations.tsv"),
 obs_cycle=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_MAG_models_2026-09-14-v1/tables/model_observations.tsv"),
 sc_condition=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_condition_models_2026-09-14-v1/DNA_suppression_scenarios.tsv"),
 sc_cycle=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_MAG_models_2026-09-14-v1/tables/DNA_suppression_scenarios.tsv"),
 links=file.path(root,"biofilm_candidate_phage_crosswalk_2026-09-14-v1/candidate_summary.tsv"),
 genes=file.path(root,"mag_functional_concentration_combined_2026-09-13-v1/tables/membership_and_original_statistics.tsv.gz"))
hash <- function(p) digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
before <- vapply(paths,hash,character(1)); m <- fread(paths['models']); links <- fread(paths['links'])
obs <- rbindlist(list(fread(paths['obs_condition']),fread(paths['obs_cycle'])),fill=TRUE)
sc1 <- fread(paths['sc_condition']); sc1[,specification:="condition_only"]
sc <- rbindlist(list(sc1,fread(paths['sc_cycle'])),fill=TRUE)
spec <- c("condition_only","categorical_cycle")
sc_all <- copy(sc)
sc <- sc[specification %in% spec]; obs <- obs[specification %in% spec & predictor=="DNA"]
stopifnot(nrow(sc)==392,uniqueN(sc$MAG_ID)==14,nrow(obs)==336,nrow(m)==168,
 all(sc[suppression==0,delta_score]==0),all(sc$low<=sc$delta_score),all(sc$high>=sc$delta_score))
check <- merge(sc,m[predictor=="DNA",.(MAG_ID,phase,specification,beta)],by=c("MAG_ID","phase","specification"))
stopifnot(nrow(check)==392,max(abs(check$delta_score-check$beta*log2(1-check$suppression)))<1e-10)
links[,label:=paste(ifelse(is.na(genus)|genus=="","Unclassified",genus),sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_0*","/",MAG_ID))]
setorder(links,label); ids <- links$MAG_ID; labs <- links$label
ranking <- sc[suppression==.5,.(positive_views=sum(delta_score>0),median_change=median(delta_score),min_change=min(delta_score),max_change=max(delta_score)),by=MAG_ID]
setorderv(ranking,c("positive_views","median_change","MAG_ID"),c(-1,-1,1))
ranking[,rank:=seq_len(.N)];ranking[,selected_main:=rank<=12]
selected_ids <- ranking[selected_main==TRUE,MAG_ID]
stopifnot(length(selected_ids)==12,nrow(ranking)==14)
ids <- ranking$MAG_ID; labs <- links[match(ids,MAG_ID),label]
decorate <- function(d) {
 d[,mag_label:=factor(MAG_ID,levels=ids,labels=labs)]
 d[,model:=factor(specification,levels=spec,labels=c("Condition adjusted","Condition + cycle"))]
 d[,phase_label:=factor(phase,levels=c("initial","backflush"),labels=c("Initial","Backflush"))]
 d
}
sc <- decorate(sc); obs <- decorate(obs)
base <- theme_classic(base_size=7)+theme(axis.text=element_text(size=6.5),axis.title=element_text(size=7),
 strip.background=element_rect(fill="#F3F3F3",colour=NA),strip.text=element_text(size=6.5),
 legend.text=element_text(size=6.5),legend.title=element_blank(),plot.margin=margin(3,4,3,4))
phase_cols <- c(Initial="#176B8C",Backflush="#C57922")
condition_cols <- c(control="#8FCB8A",treatment="#7E57C2")
example_a <- obs[MAG_ID=="TBF3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000057"]
example_b <- obs[MAG_ID=="TBF3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000025"]
stopifnot(nrow(example_a)==24,nrow(example_b)==24)
fit_panel <- function(d,title,y_title=TRUE) {
 ggplot(d,aes(score,fitted,colour=condition))+
  geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,colour="grey65",linetype=2,linewidth=.3)+
  geom_point(size=1.4)+
  geom_text(aes(label=cycle),nudge_x=.13,nudge_y=.055,colour="black",size=2,show.legend=FALSE)+
  facet_grid(phase_label~model)+
  scale_colour_manual(values=condition_cols,labels=c("Control","Treatment"))+
  coord_fixed(xlim=c(-1.5,1.9),ylim=c(-1.5,1.9))+
  labs(x="Observed cleaning score",y=if(y_title) "Fitted cleaning score" else NULL,title=title)+base+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",plot.title=element_text(size=7))
}
A <- fit_panel(example_a,"Azonexus TBF3/57")
B <- fit_panel(example_b,"UBA8904 TBF3/25",y_title=FALSE)
curve <- m[predictor=="DNA" & specification %in% spec,.(suppression=seq(0,.95,length.out=191)),by=.(MAG_ID,phase,specification,beta)]
curve[,delta_score:=beta*log2(1-suppression)];curve <- decorate(curve)
C <- ggplot(curve[MAG_ID%in%selected_ids],aes(suppression*100,delta_score,colour=phase_label,linetype=model,group=interaction(phase_label,model)))+
 geom_hline(yintercept=0,colour="grey75",linewidth=.25)+geom_line(linewidth=.5)+
 facet_wrap(~mag_label,ncol=3,scales="free_y")+
 scale_colour_manual(values=phase_cols)+scale_linetype_manual(values=c("solid","dashed"))+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,50,95))+labs(x="Hypothetical decrease in whole-MAG abundance (%)",y="Change in cleaning score")+
 base+theme(legend.position="bottom",panel.spacing=unit(3,"mm"))
top <- (A+B+plot_layout(guides="collect")) & theme(legend.position="bottom")
fig <- top/C+plot_layout(heights=c(1,1.75))+plot_annotation(tag_levels="A")
dir.create(file.path(out,"figures"),recursive=TRUE);dir.create(file.path(out,"tables"));dir.create(file.path(out,"source"))
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/figure7-candidate-suppression.pdf"),fig,width=190,height=245,units="mm",device="pdf",useDingbats=FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/preview.png"),fig,width=190,height=245,units="mm",dpi=180,bg="white",device=ragg::agg_png)
# Complete uncertainty view, not a selective set of intervals.
half <- copy(sc_all[suppression==.5]);half[,mag_label:=factor(MAG_ID,levels=rev(ids),labels=rev(labs))]
half[,phase_label:=factor(phase,levels=c("initial","backflush"),labels=c("Initial","Backflush"))]
half[,model:=factor(specification,levels=c(spec,"linear_cycle"),labels=c("Condition adjusted","Condition + cycle","Condition + linear cycle"))]
stopifnot(nrow(half)==84,!anyNA(half$model))
interval <- ggplot(half,aes(delta_score,mag_label,colour=phase_label))+
 geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype=2,colour="grey60",linewidth=.3)+
 geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=low,xmax=high),orientation="y",width=.15,linewidth=.35,position=position_dodge(width=.45))+
 geom_point(size=1.5,position=position_dodge(width=.45))+facet_grid(~model)+
 scale_colour_manual(values=phase_cols)+scale_x_continuous(trans=scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma=.5),breaks=c(-100,0,100))+
 labs(x="Change in cleaning score at 50% lower abundance (95% coefficient intervals)",y=NULL)+base+
 theme(legend.position="bottom",axis.text.y=element_text(size=7))
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/figure7-interval-companion.pdf"),interval,width=190,height=150,units="mm",device="pdf",useDingbats=FALSE)
writeLines(c("Interval companion to Figure 6.","All 14 candidate MAGs at a hypothetical 50% reduction in whole-MAG abundance, evaluated separately using initial and backflush predictors. Points show conditional score changes and horizontal intervals show coefficient-based nominal 95% confidence intervals. Columns retain condition-only, categorical-cycle and linear-cycle specifications. The common horizontal axis has a symmetric pseudo-log transformation (sigma = 0.5); labels are original index units. All 84 contrasts are retained, without significance selection."),file.path(out,"INTERVAL_CAPTION.txt"))
eq <- list(expression(R[k]==frac(I[k],I[k]+BF[k])~~bar(R)==frac(R[cells]+R[protein]+R[polysaccharides],3)),
 expression(z(X[i])==frac(X[i]-bar(X),s[X])~~S[i]==frac(1,2)*z(bar(R)[i])+frac(1,2)*z(L[i])),
 expression(Delta*x==log[2](1-f)~~Delta*hat(S)==hat(beta)[x]*log[2](1-f)))
for(i in seq_along(eq)) {
 ragg::agg_png(file.path(out,"figures",paste0("methods-equation-",i,".png")),width=170,height=20,units="mm",res=300,background="white")
 grid.newpage();grid.text(eq[[i]],gp=gpar(fontsize=11));dev.off()
}
fwrite(sc,file.path(out,"tables/plotted_suppression_scenarios.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(curve,file.path(out,"tables/dense_plotting_grid.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(half,file.path(out,"tables/50_percent_intervals.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(rbindlist(list(example_a,example_b)),file.path(out,"tables/observed_fitted_examples.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(links,file.path(out,"tables/candidate_phage_links.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(m,file.path(out,"tables/all_168_model_results.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("Figure 6: Modelled cleaning-score responses to candidate MAG suppression.",
 "A) Observed and fitted cleaning-performance scores for Azonexus TBF3/57 using whole-MAG DNA abundance. Columns show the condition-adjusted model (score ~ condition + MAG abundance) and the additive condition- and categorical-cycle-adjusted model (score ~ condition + factor(cycle) + MAG abundance); no condition-by-cycle interaction was fitted. Rows show initial and backflush predictors. Colours identify control and treatment, numbers identify cleaning cycles, and dashed diagonals indicate agreement. Each model contains six observations.",
 "B) Observed and fitted cleaning-performance scores for UBA8904 TBF3/25, displayed as in A. UBA8904 carried six treatment-upregulated biofilm-associated genes and an existing exact-ID viral host link.",
 "C) Model-implied score changes across hypothetical 0-95% decreases in whole-MAG abundance for all 14 MAGs carrying treatment-upregulated biofilm-associated genes. Initial and backflush predictions are shown in blue and orange; solid and dashed lines denote condition-adjusted and cycle-adjusted models. Changes are calculated as Delta S = beta log2(1-r), where r is the suppressed fraction, with all other model terms and score normalization held fixed. Positive changes indicate higher cleaning-performance scores. Panels have separate y-axis ranges. Curves show point estimates; complete 95% coefficient intervals at 50% suppression, linear-cycle sensitivity results and extrapolation flags accompany the figure."),file.path(out,"FIGURE_CAPTION.txt"))
stopifnot(identical(before,vapply(paths,hash,character(1))))
fwrite(data.table(path=paths,sha256=before),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
file.copy(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"),file.path(out,"source/figure7_candidate_suppression.qmd"))
writeLines(c("PASS: all 14 candidates; 392 frozen DNA scenarios; two phases and two specifications.",
 "PASS: zero-suppression identity, signed log2 contrast and interval ordering independently checked.",
 "PASS: all source SHA256 values unchanged. No fits rerun, no outcome/scaling changes.",
 "PASS: 48 observed/fitted points across eight six-observation Azonexus and UBA8904 models; 84 interval contrasts including linear-cycle sensitivity.",
 "Figure is a preview, not a live manuscript update. Curves do not include RNA suppression."),file.path(out,"VALIDATION.txt"))
genes <- fread(paths['genes'])
stopifnot(nrow(genes[set_id=="biofilm_combined"])==3905,nrow(genes[set_id=="SOS_response"])==523,
 nrow(genes[set_id=="biofilm_combined"&FDR<.05])==179,nrow(genes[set_id=="SOS_response"&FDR<.05])==14)
counts <- genes[,.(biofilm_up=sum(set_id=="biofilm_combined"&FDR<.05&logFC>0),
 biofilm_down=sum(set_id=="biofilm_combined"&FDR<.05&logFC<0),
 SOS_up=sum(set_id=="SOS_response"&FDR<.05&logFC>0),SOS_down=sum(set_id=="SOS_response"&FDR<.05&logFC<0)),by=MAG_ID]
tab <- merge(merge(ranking,links[,.(MAG_ID,label,linked_contigs)],by="MAG_ID"),counts,by="MAG_ID",all.x=TRUE)
setorder(tab,rank);stopifnot(all(tab$biofilm_up>0),nrow(tab)==14,sum(tab$biofilm_up)==31)
fwrite(tab,file.path(out,"tables/all14_candidate_ranking.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(tab[selected_main==TRUE],file.path(out,"tables/table1_candidate_prioritization.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(genes[MAG_ID%in%ids&FDR<.05],file.path(out,"tables/candidate_supported_genes.tsv"),sep="\t")
tabshow <- tab[selected_main==TRUE,.(Candidate=label,`Biofilm up/down`=paste(biofilm_up,biofilm_down,sep="/"),
 `Positive views`=paste0(positive_views,"/4"),
 `Median change`=sprintf("%.2f",median_change),`Estimate range`=sprintf("%.2f to %.2f",min_change,max_change),`Phage links`=linked_contigs)]
stopifnot(all(tab$SOS_up==0),all(tab$SOS_down==0))
fwrite(tabshow,file.path(out,"tables/table1_display.tsv"),sep="\t")
foot <- "Biofilm gene counts use the original whole-transcriptome condition FDR (BH) ≤ 0.05 and coefficient direction, with the combined 3,905-gene biofilm list. None of these candidate MAGs carried significantly treatment-associated genes from the 523-gene SOS list. SOS expression and genomic heterogeneity (the exploratory DNA-damage proxy) were not used to calculate the cleaning score or rank these candidates. Positive views count predicted score increases at 50% lower whole-MAG abundance across initial/backflush and condition-only/categorical-cycle models. Median and range summarize the four point estimates in cleaning-score units; the range is not a confidence interval. Complete separate estimates and 95% intervals for all 14 MAGs and all three model specifications are supplied in the companion. Ranking uses descending positive views, descending median change, then MAG identifier, without P value selection. Links count exact-ID CRISPR/SpacePHARER-linked viral contigs."
html <- c('<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;margin:32px;color:#222}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px}th,td{padding:10px 12px;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}th:first-child,td:first-child{text-align:left}th{border-top:2px solid #222;border-bottom:2px solid #222;background:#f4f4f4}p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;max-width:1100px}</style></head><body><h2>Table 1.  paste0('<table><thead><tr>',paste0('<th>',names(tabshow),'</th>',collapse=''),'</tr></thead><tbody>'),

ragg::agg_png(file.path(out,"Table1_preview.png"),width=240,height=155,units="mm",res=180,background="white")

tg <- gridExtra::tableGrob(tabshow,rows=NULL,theme=gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(base_size=8,padding=unit(c(3,3),"mm")))
grid.draw(editGrob(tg,vp=viewport(x=.5,y=.56,width=.94,height=.75)))
grid.text(paste(strwrap(foot,width=155),collapse="\n"),x=.04,y=.07,just=c("left","bottom"),gp=gpar(fontsize=7))

for(file in c("FIGURE_CAPTION.txt","INTERVAL_CAPTION.txt")) {
 text <- readLines(file.path(out,file));text <- gsub("Figure 6","Figure 7",text,fixed=TRUE)
 text <- gsub("each of the 14 candidate MAGs","each of the 12 displayed candidate MAGs",text,fixed=TRUE)
 text <- gsub("for all 14 MAGs carrying","for the 12 highest-ranked MAGs carrying",text,fixed=TRUE)
 if(file=="FIGURE_CAPTION.txt")text <- c(text,"The 12 displayed candidates are ranked by the number of positive score changes at 50% suppression across the four phase-by-specification views, then by descending median change and finally by MAG identifier.  writeLines(text,file.path(out,file))
}
```
